correctness.rationale: For any order-preserving f with f^3=f^2, the idempotent e=f^2 has contiguous fibers rooted at its fixed points; f preserves each fiber and each root. On a one-sided rooted interval of length a, monotone g with g²=0 and j nonzero image values has exactly C(a,2j) choices by first choosing the maximal image and applying Vandermonde. Rooted intervals contribute uv z[(1-z)/((1-z)^2-vz²)]², and taking the geometric series yields F(z;u,v) as claimed. Extracting coefficients proves C(k+r-1,r-k)C(n+k-1,2r-1), zero off support; r=k means idempotence. A monotone map has no cycles longer than one, so f^4=f² is equivalent to f³=f². Independently enumerated all nondecreasing functions through n=8; totals 1,3,10,33,108,352,1145,3721 and strict n=5=53 confirm low-rank boundaries.
residual_risks: Finite checks do not establish all dimensions; the domain-wide conclusion rests on the reconstructed mathematical proof.
